transform.sql: WITH POOL_DP_VOL_CAP AS( SELECT PD_PLC.DATETIME, PD_PLC.POOL_ID, CAST(SUM(PD_VVC.USED_CAPACITY) / 1024 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS USED_CAPACITY FROM PD_PLC JOIN PD_VVC ON PD_PLC.DATETIME = PD_VVC.DATETIME AND PD_PLC.POOL_ID = PD_VVC.POOL_ID GROUP BY PD_PLC.DATETIME, PD_PLC.POOL_ID) SELECT PD_PLC.DATETIME, CAST(SUM(PD_PLC.PHYSICAL_CAPACITY_TOTAL) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_PHYSICAL_CAPACITY_TOTAL, CAST(SUM(PD_PLC.PHYSICAL_CAPACITY_FREE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_PHYSICAL_CAPACITY_FREE, CAST(SUM(PD_PLC.PHYSICAL_CAPACITY_USED) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_PHYSICAL_CAPACITY_USED, MAX(PD_PLC.PHYSICAL_CAPACITY_USAGE_RATE) AS MAX_PHYSICAL_CAPACITY_USAGE_RATE, CAST(SUM(PD_PLC.TOTAL_MANAGED_CAPACITY) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_TOTAL_MANAGED_CAPACITY, CAST(SUM(PD_PLC.TOTAL_ACTUAL_CAPACITY) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_LOGICAL_CAPACITY_TOTAL, CAST(SUM(PD_PLC.FREE_CAPACITY) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_LOGICAL_CAPACITY_FREE, CAST(SUM(PD_PLC.USED_CAPACITY) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_LOGICAL_CAPACITY_USED, MAX(PD_PLC.USAGE_RATE) AS MAX_LOGICAL_CAPACITY_USAGE_RATE, CAST(SUM( CASE WHEN PD_PLC.DKC_SAVING_CAPACITY > 0 THEN PD_PLC.DKC_SAVING_CAPACITY ELSE null END ) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_DKC_SAVING_CAPACITY, CAST(SUM( CASE WHEN PD_PLC.FMC_POOL_CAPACITY_SAVING > 0 THEN PD_PLC.FMC_POOL_CAPACITY_SAVING ELSE null END ) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_FMC_POOL_CAPACITY_SAVING, CAST(SUM( CASE WHEN PD_PLC.SAVING_CAPACITY > 0 THEN PD_PLC.SAVING_CAPACITY ELSE null END ) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_SAVING_CAPACITY, CAST(SUM( CASE WHEN PD_PLC.DATA_VOLUME_USED_CAPACITY > 0 THEN PD_PLC.DATA_VOLUME_USED_CAPACITY ELSE POOL_DP_VOL_CAP.USED_CAPACITY END ) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_DATA_VOLUME_USED_CAPACITY FROM PD_PLC LEFT OUTER JOIN POOL_DP_VOL_CAP ON PD_PLC.DATETIME = POOL_DP_VOL_CAP.DATETIME AND PD_PLC.POOL_ID = POOL_DP_VOL_CAP.POOL_ID GROUP BY PD_PLC.DATETIME;
